name: pro.fantasytrade/trade-analyzer
title: FantasyTrade Pro
description: NFL fantasy football trades: verdicts, player and pick values, rankings, movers, rookies, offers.

tools.name: evaluate_trade
tools.description: Judge an NFL fantasy football trade (dynasty or redraft): who wins, how confident the verdict is, the value of every player and pick on each side, the reasons, and what would even it out. Use for "is this trade fair?", "who wins this trade?", "should I accept?". Returns a link that opens the trade in the FantasyTrade Pro calculator.

you_get.description: What the user would receive. Each entry is a player name ("Ja'Marr Chase") or a rookie draft pick: "2027 1st" (add early, mid or late if known, e.g. "early 2027 1st") or an exact slot "2027 1.03"

you_give.description: What the user would give up. Each entry is a player name ("Ja'Marr Chase") or a rookie draft pick: "2027 1st" (add early, mid or late if known, e.g. "early 2027 1st") or an exact slot "2027 1.03"

league.description: League settings. Omit for the default: 12-team dynasty Superflex, full PPR, 1 QB / 2 RB / 3 WR / 1 TE / 1 Flex (+1 Superflex)

format.description: dynasty (keeper, multi-year value) or redraft (rest of this season only)

superflex.description: True if teams can start a second quarterback (Superflex or 2QB). Default: true for dynasty, false for redraft

ppr.description: Points per reception: 1 full PPR, 0.5 half, 0 standard

te_premium.description: Extra points per tight end reception

tools.name: get_player_values
tools.description: Current trade value of one or more NFL players for a fantasy football league: value on a 0 to 10,000 scale with a likely range, overall and position rank, projected points per game, the change over the last week and four weeks, points scored last week, and in dynasty the rookie draft pick that is a fair trade for him. Use to compare players or answer "what is X worth?".

league.description: League settings. Omit for the default: 12-team dynasty Superflex, full PPR, 1 QB / 2 RB / 3 WR / 1 TE / 1 Flex (+1 Superflex)

ppr.description: Points per reception: 1 full PPR, 0.5 half, 0 standard

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Fantasy football trade-value rankings for a league format (dynasty or redraft, Superflex or 1QB), for all positions or one of QB, RB, WR, TE, and optionally one NFL team. Returns rank, value and one-week change, 25 players at a time by default.

tools.name: suggest_fair_trade_returns
tools.description: Given the players or picks on one side of a fantasy football trade, list fair returns for them: straight swaps, two-player packages, a player plus a pick, and picks only. Use for "what can I get for X?" or "what should I offer for X?".

assets.description: The side of the trade that is already decided: what the user would give up (or wants to acquire). Each entry is a player name ("Ja'Marr Chase") or a rookie draft pick: "2027 1st" (add early, mid or late if known, e.g. "early 2027 1st") or an exact slot "2027 1.03"

tools.name: get_value_movers
tools.description: The NFL players whose fantasy football trade value rose or fell the most over the last week (or up to four weeks), in dynasty or redraft, Superflex or 1QB, for all positions or one. Returns each player's value, change and points scored last week. Use for "who is rising?", "buy low or sell high candidates", "whose value dropped?".

superflex.description: True for Superflex or 2QB leagues. Default: true for dynasty, false for redraft

position.description: Only this position. Omit for all positions

weeks.description: Compare with this many weeks ago: 1 for the last week, up to 4

limit.description: How many risers and how many fallers to return

tools.name: get_rookie_rankings
tools.description: The next dynasty rookie class (college prospects, not yet NFL players): a 12-team rookie mock draft for Superflex or 1QB leagues, or rankings for one position with college statistics. Each prospect has school, class, whether he can return to college, projected NFL draft round, mock draft pick and that pick's trade value.

position.description: Rank this position only, with college statistics. Omit for the mock draft order across positions

superflex.description: Mock draft for Superflex (true) or 1QB (false) leagues
